name: Newspaper page cuts
what: A dark photo above a printed newspaper page; every third of a second the page cuts to a new layout (an italic headline, a big serif one, a sans one, a condensed one over a strip of pictures...), each cut smeared sideways for a frame, with a slow push-in between cuts. Your headline lands in each layout.
origin: MotionLab's own build in the Editorial warm look (2026-10)
motion: f0-f139: a hard cut every 10 f (f10, f20 ... f130) through 7 page layouts, twice; the cut frame is smeared sideways, the next is nearly sharp (f11), the page then holds with a slow push-in (0.9 % in 9 f) and the last frame of each page smears a little; the photo above is re-cropped at every cut

tracks.name: page cuts
tracks.what: a hard cut to the next of 7 page layouts every 10 frames (the cycle runs twice)

tracks.name: cut smear
tracks.what: the cut frame smears sideways (about 7 px), the next frame is nearly sharp, the last frame of each page smears a little

tracks.name: push-in
tracks.what: each page and its photo push in slowly (0.9 % in 9 frames)

tracks.name: photo crop
tracks.what: the photo above is re-cropped (zoomed 1.0 to 1.55 times) at every cut and the page's top edge moves
